title: Normal force on B
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the normal force on object B (or the pressure from B on the ground) as 4mg in part (1).

title: Tension in rope
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the tension in the rope as 5mg when C has mass 5m and is in equilibrium.

title: Spring force equilibrium
description: Important: The student must apply force balance on object A in the new equilibrium to find the spring force as 3mg.

title: Spring elongation calculation
description: Important: The student must use Hooke's law to find the new elongation x1 = 3mg/k and the initial compression x2 = mg/k.

title: Total height risen
description: Essential: The student must correctly sum the spring length changes to find the height A rises as h = x1 + x2 = 4mg/k in part (2).

title: Forgetting initial compression
description: Pitfall: The student might only consider the new elongation and omit the initial compression of the spring, leading to an answer of 3mg/k.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: The student might incorrectly assign directions for spring force, tension, or weight, leading to wrong equilibrium equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The student may verify that the final expression 4mg/k has correct dimensions of length.
